column1: # Phase-1 data-table support: bind the bmtrick.c TU-private EWRAM static
# sTrapPool (struct Trap[TRAP_MAX_COUNT=64], 512 B) so the trap functions that
# live in separately-graduated files (GetTrapAt/AddTrap/...) can graduate to
# matching C. JP 0x0203A610 read directly from the trap functions' literal pool
# (e.g. asm/GetTrapAt.s `=0x0203A610`), which is authoritative; the extern decl
# in each graduated file aliases this exact RAM location.
